# Overview

When every voice moves the same way, the chord keeps its shape and **slides** along the neck. This cluster covers the borrowed major chords ♭VII and ♭VI, and the Andalusian descent.

Back to [the move map](map.html). Standard tuning, high E at the top (tick *⚙ low E on top* on any fretboard to flip them all); every figure plays sound.

# Lessons

## ♭VII and ♭VI {#flat-vii-and-flat-vi}

Two borrowed major chords from the parallel minor that you slide as a whole shape:

- **♭VII** (B♭ in C): a whole step below the tonic, the rock and Mixolydian sound, I → ♭VII → IV → I. On the neck, slide the tonic shape **down two frets**.
- **♭VI → ♭VII → I** (A♭ → B♭ → C): a triumphant cadence, the same barre sliding **up in whole steps**.
- **V → ♭VI**: a deceptive cadence that also borrows (compare [Cadences](fifth-motion.html#cadences)).

::: {.mf-widget data-widget="progression" data-position="3" data-presets="♭VII = C B♭ F C | I ♭VII IV I; ♭VI–♭VII–I = C A♭ B♭ C | I ♭VI ♭VII I; V → ♭VI = C G7 A♭ | I V7 ♭VI"}
[Interactive figure: ♭VII and ♭VI. It needs JavaScript.]{.mf-noscript}
:::

For the borrowed iv, where only one note changes, see [Borrowed iv](hold-step.html#borrowed-iv).

::: {.mf-widget data-widget="songs" data-moves="flat7,flat67"}
[Songs: Super Mario Bros. fanfare, Sweet Child o' Mine. They play in the interactive version, which needs JavaScript.]{.mf-noscript}
:::

## The Andalusian cadence {#andalusian-cadence}

**i → ♭VII → ♭VI → V** (Am → G → F → E): a bass line stepping down the minor
scale, ending on a **major** V borrowed from harmonic minor. Its G♯ pulls
back to A. On the neck it is the same barre shape stepping down, the sound of
flamenco.

::: {.mf-widget data-widget="progression" data-position="5" data-loop="" data-chords="Am G F E" data-labels="i ♭VII ♭VI V"}
[Interactive figure: the Andalusian cadence. It needs JavaScript.]{.mf-noscript}
:::

::: {.mf-widget data-widget="songs" data-moves="andalusian"}
[Songs: Sultans of Swing, Hit the Road Jack, California Dreamin'. They play in the interactive version, which needs JavaScript.]{.mf-noscript}
:::
